raw_context:
Cipla Medpro South Africa (Pty) Limited is
the third-largest pharmaceutical company in South Africa
. Headquartered in Cape Town, it is a wholly owned subsidiary of India's
Cipla Limited
, supplying affordable generic and chronic medicines across the public and private healthcare sectors.
LinkedIn South Africa
Cipla Africa
Key Focus Areas
Core Therapeutic Segments:
Respiratory care, antiretrovirals (ARVs for HIV/AIDS), cardiology, urology, oncology, diabetes, and central nervous system (CNS) conditions.
www.sapcconference.za.org
Market Position:
One of the top and fastest-growing medicine suppliers in South Africa, providing cost-effective alternatives to branded pharmaceuticals.
Pharmaceutical Technology
Corporate Background
Origins:
Established and grown locally before expanding via corporate structures, eventually becoming fully acquired by its long-term partner Cipla India in a major 2013 investment.
Stellenbosch Business School
Operations:
Manufactures and distributes medications tailored to Southern African health needs through localized facilities like Cipla Medpro Manufacturing and Cipla Distribution Gateway.
